title: 第二十七章 不怕
novel_title: 魔头别夺舍了，我们正道快没人了
content_zh:
部署既定，仙灵剑宗众弟子旋即展开行动。

    此事尚有一关键因素时机。

    眼下他们这几位仙灵剑宗真传抵达的消息，多半尚未传入城主府耳中。

    趁此时机出手，对方尚不知发生何事，冒头便会被迎头痛击。

    故而，速度至关重要。

    季南北与白洁亦悄然潜至城主府外，收敛气息、隐匿身形，静候动静。

    蹲守之际，白洁好奇问道:

    “师姐，若对方沉得住气，始终不出手，又当如何?”

    他们不可能在此干耗-尚需前往道宗。又无确凿证据指认对方图谋不轨，仅凭推测而已。

    若对方当真按兵不动，该如何是好?

    季南北摇头轻笑。

    “简单。上报宗门，调遣数十元婴、三两化神，光明正大行至城主府外，高声喝问:‘我等疑心城主府内藏匿大妖魔头，速速开门，容我等除魔卫道!”

    白洁听得瞠目结舌。

    “这......师姐，这般行事当真无碍?”

    季南北摊手。

    “能有何碍?师妹须明白，这世间有实力方有话语权，否则喊冤亦无门路。我等背靠仙灵剑宗，有时便可不顾成规，以势压人。”

    白洁心神为之震动。师姐果真了得，不论情爱抑或世情，皆看得如此通透!

    而季南北只觉，顶着萧京溪的身份行事着实痛快。

    “仙二代”就是好，横推便是，无须顾忌其他。

    当我疑你窝藏妖魔巨擘，那你最好当真窝藏了，否则......

    嘿嘿。

    本体那边我谨慎低调，小剑仙这儿我重拳出击!

    另一边。

    得季南北授意，汪天韵指挥数名内门弟子，尽数赶往妖兽盘踞的官道，径直清剿妖兽。

    汪天韵本人则隐于暗处，并未现身。若有一位真传露面，对方或会多有顾忌;但仅是一些内门弟子出手，则易迷惑对手。

    此时官道上聚集的妖兽，已有约三十头之数。

    其中一头达筑基初期，余者皆为练气期。

    数名筑基境的内门弟子联手，虽稍费周折，风险却不算大。

    毕竟皆是仙灵剑宗出身，纵非同境顶尖，也属门中较出众者，方有资格入此宗门修习。
content_en:
The deployment was finalized, and the disciples of the Immortal Sword Sect immediately launched into action.

    There is still one key factor in this matter: timing.

    At present, the news of the arrival of these immortal sword sect true disciples has probably not reached the ears of the city lord's mansion.

    If you take advantage of this opportunity to take action, the opponent will be hit head-on if you take the lead before they know what is going on.

    Therefore, speed is of the essence.

    Ji Nanbei and Bai Jie also quietly sneaked outside the city lord's palace, gathering their breath, hiding their bodies, and waiting for any movement.

    While squatting, Bai Jie asked curiously:

    "Senior sister, what if the other party can keep his composure and never take action?"

    They can't waste time here - they still need to go to Daozong. There is no conclusive evidence that the other party has evil intentions, it is just speculation.

    What should we do if the opponent really refuses to move?

    Ji Nanbei shook his head and chuckled.

    "Simple. Report to the sect, dispatch dozens of Nascent Souls and three liang of transformed gods, march brightly and openly to the outside of the City Lord's Mansion, and shout loudly: 'We suspect that there is a big demon head hiding in the City Lord's Mansion, open the door quickly, and let us eliminate the demons and defend the way!"

    Bai Jie was stunned when she heard this.

    "Senior sister, is it really okay to act like this?"

    Ji Nanbei spread his hands.

    "What's the problem? Junior sister must understand that only those with strength have the right to speak in this world, otherwise there is no way to cry for injustice. With our backing to the Immortal Spirit Sword Sect, sometimes we can ignore the rules and use our power to suppress others."

    Bai Jie's mind was shaken. Senior sister is really amazing, whether it is love or the world, she sees everything so clearly!

    But Ji Nanbei felt that it was really satisfying to act under Xiao Jingxi's identity.

    The "Second Generation of Immortals" are good, just push them horizontally, there is no need to worry about anything else.

    When I suspect you of harboring a monster giant, you'd better take it seriously, otherwise...

    Hehe.

    On the main body side, I am cautious and low-key, on the Little Sword Fairy side, I attack hard!

    other side.

    With Ji Nanbei's instruction, Wang Tianyun commanded several inner disciples to rush to the official road where the monsters were entrenched, and directly wiped out the monsters.

    Wang Tianyun himself hid in the darkness and did not appear. If a true disciple shows up, the opponent may be wary; but if only some inner disciples take action, it is easy to confuse the opponent.

    At this time, there were about thirty monster beasts gathered on the official road.

    One of them has reached the early stage of foundation building, and the rest are all in the Qi training stage.

    Several inner disciples of the Foundation Establishment Realm joined forces. Although it took a little effort, the risk was not great.

    After all, they are all from the Immortal Sword Sect. Even if they are not at the top of the same realm, they are still more outstanding in the sect, so they are qualified to enter this sect to practice.
